title: Centralize business and implementation rule management under permission core
summary: Explicit user directive: all business and implementation rules are centrally managed by permission-core. Language allowlist and prohibited tools remain Codex principles;implementation allocation is adaptive subordinate business regulation. Preserve domain semantic evidence,execution/resource/independent verdict owners,permissions,single authority,current generations,atomic promotion/rollback and private custody. No declaration of physical rule migration or PostgreSQL retirement completion.
problem: B5 excludes languages while latest directive makes them principles;B164/B165/D73 retain module-owned primary rule content whereas user requires central permission-core management
acceptance: language boundary and prohibited tools stay principles
business and implementation rule registration/change/version/publication/access/revocation/audit have one management owner permission-core
no parallel module primary editable rule source
domain semantic correctness and existing independent verdict/execution/resource authority preserved
policy content cannot grant permissions or become Codex

changes.proposed: NORMATIVE-SURFACE:principles,articles,edicts,responsibilities,authority boundaries,prohibitions and cross-layer invariants only;the current Codex is the sole normative authority. DELEGATION:all business and implementation rules are subordinate adaptive operational rules centrally managed by permission-core under B5. MANAGEMENT:one canonical rule location,current version,registration,controlled change,validation,publication,access,revocation,conflict handling and audit;no module owns a parallel writable primary rule copy. SEMANTICS:one registered domain semantic owner supplies proposals and evidence;management does not transfer business execution,resource governance,permission decisions,independent verdict or canonical domain data authority. CONSUMPTION:existing executors use validated scope-bound current projections through registered typed contracts;missing,stale,unauthorized or conflicting rules block affected work. ADAPTATION:language/tool boundaries,current correctness/performance/independent evaluation evidence,existing permissions/resources and atomic promotion/rollback remain controlling. CLASSIFICATION:separate legal principles from business/implementation content before storage;keep identities,lineage and lifecycle distinct;no business rule silently becomes law.

CONTROL:B162 defines the current five-core responsibility boundary;B5 excludes implementation and business rules from this provision and all other law. DECISION-CORE:owns governed decisions and result acceptance within its granted general scope,without direct execution. PERMISSION-CORE:owns identity,permission,governance-directory accountability and unified central management of business and implementation rules under B5/B164/B165,without business execution,independent-verdict ownership or Codex content self-authorization. RUNTIME-CORE:owns authorized execution and lifecycle control,without permission generation,self-authorization or policy alteration. AUTOMATION-CORE:owns bounded orchestration and coordination,without execution authority,permission generation or result acceptance. XINGCHENG-ASSISTANT:owns independent inspection,audit and notification,without substituting user choice or acquiring Xingcheng data,repair,upgrade or learning authority. XINGCHENG:is a separate institution with independent identity,lifecycle and exclusive owner-held data;its bounded special-law powers remain governed by B81 and do not transfer to a tool or assistant. SUB-SOVEREIGNS:abolished and historical only. EXECUTION-BOUNDARY:authorized work is attributable to a registered owner and accountable executor;isolation containers create no business authority and modules cannot self-authorize or acquire another owner's power. OWNERSHIP:one current owner and one primary responsibility govern each capability;coordination or delegation does not expand scope. EXTERNAL-RULES:language choices,technical contracts,algorithms,parameters,business decisions and operational tuning are governed outside the Codex by the responsible owner under current permission,safety,evidence and independent-verification principles;their operational authority is not legal authority. LEGACY:implementation-specific wording in this or another provision is non-operative Codex detail under B5 and remains an explicit migration gap until lawful external custody and equivalence are validated.

XINGCHENG-LANGUAGE-PRINCIPLE:the complete Xingcheng source,production runtime,training,inference,learning,evaluation,data-processing and internal-tool surface permits exactly C/C++/C#/F#/Rust/Go/Julia/JavaScript;this law fixes the permitted language boundary and no subordinate business rule,toolchain or contract expands it. NATIVE-ONLY:production uses verified precompiled native artifacts under B166;interpreters,script engines,runtime-source compilation and unregistered execution paths are prohibited. ADAPTIVE-BUSINESS-RULES:per-capability language assignment,implementation owner allocation,tool names,versions,configuration and measured automatic selection belong to subordinate registered owner contracts under B5;adaptation selects exactly one current primary implementation owner only within existing authority,permission,scope and resource budgets using current correctness,performance and independent evaluation evidence. ROLE-INVARIANCE:adaptive language selection never reassigns sovereign identity,governance authority,permission decisions,independent evaluation-verdict ownership or canonical data authority. CHANGE:current typed compatibility,evaluation,resource,permission and generation-bound evidence must support atomic promotion and verified rollback;missing,stale,conflicting or regressing evidence retains the last verified implementation or fails closed. ONE-OWNER:no duplicate primary implementation,scheduler,orchestrator,model runtime or structured authority. INTERNET:purpose-bound scoped public-data access through a registered native owner channel is bounded,cancellable,validated and audited;retrieved content is untrusted non-authoritative input. EXTERNAL-EXECUTION:no external model,cloud inference,remote code execution,external execution engine,third-party inference or training framework,external capability service or arbitrary external dependency becomes a Xingcheng runtime,producer,consumer,reference,fallback or authority. PLATFORM:operating-system facilities,hardware drivers,approved build toolchains and governed typed channels provide platform boundaries only and gain no capability,model,data or authority ownership. TRAINING:training remains internal to Xingcheng and no retired independent training role is restored. FAILURE:excluded language,interpreted or unregistered execution,unbounded or unaudited access,contract conflict or incomplete evidence is denied fail-closed. EXPLICIT-TOOL-BANS:Python,NumPy,JAX/XLA,PyTorch/Torch,pytest,Bun and WebView script execution are forbidden inside Xingcheng;allowing JavaScript source never authorizes those banned execution tools or interpreted production. CENTRAL-RULE-MANAGEMENT:all subordinate business and implementation rules,including adaptive allocation,are centrally managed by permission-core under B5/B164/B165;domain expertise and existing execution,independent verdict,resource and authority boundaries remain unchanged;local contracts/configuration are current validated projections only.

CENTRAL-RULE-MANAGEMENT:permission-core is the single management owner of the unified business and implementation rule registry;discovery,canonical storage,registration,controlled modification,validation,versioning,publication,access,revocation,conflict detection and audit remain one governed responsibility. SEMANTIC-RESPONSIBILITY:registered domain owners propose and validate business meaning under existing authority;permission-core cannot unilaterally change business semantics or assume execution/independent-verdict authority. IDENTITY:every rule binds one semantic owner,scope,controlling Codex principle,typed contract,source lineage,current generation and integrity evidence;concrete schema fields,keys and rule-kind declarations are subordinate business specifications managed within this same registry. GENERATION:immutable history,one current canonical rule version,atomic publication,current consumer compatibility and revocation fences;prior projections cannot restore authority. CONSUMPTION:each executor reads only its validated scoped current rules and authorized shared contracts;module-local files and indexes are derived views,not primary rule stores. ADAPTATION:current evidence and permission/resource bounds control selection and activation;one primary implementation,independent verification,atomic promotion and verified rollback are required. CLASSIFICATION:language boundaries and explicit tool prohibitions remain legal principles;business/implementation details remain subordinate and cannot grant permission or create another normative source. FAILURE:missing,invalid,stale,conflicting or unauthorized rules fail closed;never copy them into the Codex runtime rule index.

LANGUAGE-BOUNDARY:permitted project implementation languages are C/C++/C#/F#/Rust/Go/Julia/JavaScript;SQL is a relational storage and query contract,not an application-language owner;no subordinate rule expands this boundary. LANGUAGE-AUTHORITY:this provision is the sole current Codex-level language-allocation and UI-stack controller and records principles only;per B5 every per-capability language division,tool name,version pin,UI-shell selection and implementation detail is governed outside the Codex by the responsible owner through the registered language contract and governed dependency directories,and such external facts are subordinate operational artifacts that never amend law. NATIVE-ONLY:production uses verified precompiled native artifacts;no interpreter,script engine or runtime-source compiler enters production. PYTHON:total-ban with zero source,runtime,interpreter,environment,package,dependency,build,test,audit,training,inference,script,tool,artifact,proxy,bridge,reference or fallback. ONE-OWNER:each capability has exactly one current primary language owner under a typed boundary;allocation changes only inside the same registered capability contract and resource ceiling with atomic promotion and rollback. NO-AUTHORITY-DRIFT:language choice never creates authority,changes business semantics,bypasses permission or introduces a second scheduler or orchestrator. DATA:project-owned in-process native SQL is the structured authority target;retired implementation identities and successor choices are subordinate business declarations,not application-language owners;one registered canonical store per domain;cutover requires complete data,schema,permission,audit,transaction,recovery and current-generation parity evidence plus atomic promotion and rollback;legacy structured data is preserved as a read-only migration source until validated cutover and is never a second active writer;no retirement certification is inferred from language permission or implementation labels. FAILURE:missing or regressing evidence retains the current verified owner or fails closed. PROHIBITED-TOOLS:PostgreSQL production database execution,psql and Npgsql production SQL consumers are prohibited;no external database tool,service or subprocess executes production SQL;isolated read-only legacy capture is permitted solely within a registered bounded migration scope until independent cutover proof,never as production fallback or a second active writer. CENTRAL-RULE-MANAGEMENT:all subordinate business and implementation rules,including adaptive allocation,are centrally managed by permission-core under B5/B164/B165;domain expertise and existing execution,independent verdict,resource and authority boundaries remain unchanged;local contracts/configuration are current validated projections only.

SCOPE:the Codex determines principles,including legitimate authority,ownership,separation of duties,permission,data custody,isolation,safety,accountability,evidence,independent verification,interpretation and governed change. NORMATIVE-BOUNDARIES:permitted implementation languages and explicit prohibited tools are principles governed by current B166/B167 and applicable prohibition provisions. EXCLUSION:business rules and implementation rules do not enter the Codex;per-language assignments,algorithms,software stacks,files,paths,APIs,schemas,layouts,versions,model topology,parameters,thresholds,test composition,scheduling and business decision procedures are subordinate adaptive rules. CENTRAL-MANAGEMENT:permission-core is the sole central management owner for all business and implementation rules,including registration,controlled changes,versioning,validation,publication,access,revocation,conflict resolution and audit. DOMAIN-RESPONSIBILITY:registered domain owners propose semantic content and supply correctness evidence;existing execution and independent-verdict owners retain their responsibilities. SINGLE-RULE-SOURCE:each rule has one permission-core-managed current canonical identity and version;local contracts/configuration are bounded generation-bound projections,not independent editable rule authorities. ADAPTATION:only within current language/tool prohibitions,permission,scope,resource,typed compatibility and evidence boundaries;activate atomically with verified rollback. SUBORDINATION:central management never creates another law source,changes Codex principles,enlarges rights or self-certifies correctness. CUSTODY:manage rule definitions and opaque scoped references without copying another owner's private data or acquiring its data authority. APPLICABILITY:general provisions,special laws,ordinances,registries and local projections all follow this separation;format or registration cannot elevate business detail to law. AMBIGUITY:unresolved boundary or stale,missing,conflicting evidence fails closed.
